attributes.name: Lookout Duty
attributes.powers:
The difficulty to defeat this barrier is increased by the adventure deck number of the current scenario, if any.

If defeated, you may examine the top card of the barrier's location deck; if it is a monster, you may immediately encounter it.

If undefeated, your ship is dealt 1 Structural damage. Leave this barrier faceup on the location deck; characters at this location encounter this barrier as their first exploration each turn.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barrier Lookout Duty, change "look at" to "examine".
corrections.issue: On Lookout Duty, does "look at" mean "examine"?
